register: TQSL's station location fields, and where a Location holds each
note: P9-tqsl (QGD-STN-0009): every field TQSL asks for on its station location pages has a home on a Location, so a Location can be signed for LoTW without TQSL's own station data. Read from TQSL's published config.xml: the fields named by <pageField> in <locpages>, which are the ones an operator fills in. Nothing of TQSL's file is copied here beyond the field names. Re-check against a newer config.xml with node scripts/tqsl-fields.mjs.

CALL.why: The active callsign's, never stored on a Location (QGD-STN-0001).

GRIDSQUARE.why: A grid line or corner holds its grids in MY_VUCC_GRIDS.

US_PARK.why: TQSL's park list; ADIF has no field for it.

ZERR.why: TQSL's own line for an error message on the page, not a value.
